name: Mysterious Case of the Stolen Artefact
summary:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through time with The Mysterious Case of The Stolen Artefact, an immersive VR adventure game that brings Singapore’s past to life. Step into the shoes of a time-traveller as you explore recreated historical scenes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets tied to a priceless artefact lost in time.
